evidence.notes: Custom metadata-loaded object prefixes and modeled standard prefixes resolve to local SObjectType tokens.
Supported local flags compile, carry Pattern.pattern source text, and drive Matcher behavior.
Java-only regex features remain covered by existing UnsupportedFeature fixtures.
Queued local async aborts remain covered by async-abort-job-edges.

source.content: @isTest private class SmallPlatformFinalFixtureTest { @isTest static void localRowsAndFencesArePinned() { Id accountId = Id.valueOf('001B000001DVM9t'); System.assertNotEquals(null, accountId.getSObjectType()); Id trailId = Id.valueOf('a00B000001DVM9t'); System.assertEquals('Trail__c', trailId.getSObjectType().getDescribe().getName()); Pattern p = Pattern.compile('a.b', Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE + Pattern.DOTALL + Pattern.UNICODE_CASE); System.assertEquals('a.b', p.pattern()); String input = String.fromCharArray(new List<Integer>{65,10,66}); System.assert(p.matcher(input).matches()); } }
